fields.description:
**Related:** WAGR-465 (Referral payouts — design and user stories), WAGR-220, WAGR-1

**Summary:** Sometimes Ops finds a Sign-Up ineligible after it has been completed and paid, and a referral payment may already be out. Today there is no way to write off that Sign-Up or to show which payment it was part of.

**Requirements captured**

* Write off a completed, paid Sign-Up and log the cost.
* Include the referral payment in the write-off if one was made.
* Show which Payout each Sign-Up was part of.
* If a Sign-Up is found to be fraud after its Payout is Paid, the Payout stays locked. The Sign-Up goes to Confirmed Fraud, and the cost is logged as a write-off.

**Open questions:** Does a write-off also apply to operator revenue (the CPA), or only to referral cost? Who approves a write-off? Where is the cost reported?

**Done when:** a design exists and is reviewed with Ops, and the stories are created.

**Sources (traceable):**

* Referral and Payouts discovery, 2026-09-25 (fraud and write-off section) — https://fathom.video/calls/835861150
* Kobi notes, 2026-09-25 — Kobiwan/VAULT/Wagertech Updates.md

---

_Captured 2026-09-25 by Kobi from the WagerTech calls, Slack, Jira and sandbox review (Jul–Sep 2026). Design backlog item: requirements only, not a solution._
